These are notebooks from my own study and experiments. Each one shows the code,
the reasoning behind it, and the result I can check. I will add to this section
as the exercises develop.

::: {.project-card}
### [Linear regression from scratch](notebooks/islp-03-linear-regression/index.ipynb)

I derive least-squares coefficients and their standard errors, implement the
calculations in a small Python class, and compare the fitted coefficients with
scikit-learn. The example uses the public Advertising dataset from
*An Introduction to Statistical Learning*.

::: {.stack}
Python · NumPy · statistics · scikit-learn
:::
:::

::: {.project-card}
### [From a computational graph to one neuron](notebooks/neural-autograd/index.ipynb)

A short, runnable note from my ongoing neural-network exercises. I calculate
gradients by hand, check them against PyTorch autograd, and apply the chain rule
to the weights and bias of one tanh neuron.

::: {.stack}
Python · PyTorch · gradients · neural networks
:::
:::
